description: The Department of Govt. Printing - Amendment No. 03 made to the Printing Service Minute of the Department of Govt. Printing published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1816/12 of 26.06.2013
categorisation: This gazette notification contains amendments to the Printing Service Minutes of the Department of Government Printing, specifically detailing recruitment procedures, examination methods, and service conditions for public service positions. It focuses on public sector recruitment processes, qualification requirements, and appointment procedures administered by the Public Service Commission, which falls under public service administration rather than government structure/personnel changes.
